violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) observed handle-less plastic containers being stored inside the bulk bins of flour, rice, cornstarch, etc.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. DO NOT USE HANDLE-LESS CONTAINERS. USE SCOOPS WITH HANDLES TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION OF THE BULK FOOD.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: 1) observed an accumulation of food debris stuck in between the crevices of the prep tables 2) observed food splatter on the support pillars of the shelves at the prep tables 3) observed dark discoloration along the “dirty” side of the 3-compartment sink where the black splash guard is located
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. MORE FREQUENT CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED HANDWASHING SIGNAGE MISSING AT THE FRONT HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL EMAIL PIC A HANDWASHING POSTER THAT MAY BE POSTED AT THE SINK.
